masks.reason: Clock/date are real values and may use the configured locale.
Reference dialogue claims connectivity; the app must display its actual dialogue instead.
Reference module health and counts are illustrations, not permitted fixture values.
Camera tracking must not claim an observation without permission and a real source.
Agent names and running tasks depend on authentic runtime events.
Plan progress depends on real execution; checkmarks cannot be copied from the reference.
Memory graph and counts require actual memory events; zero/offline is valid.
Model/device values and readiness depend on a real loaded model and measurements.
Status text and lights must truthfully describe device/network/model state; frame remains compared.
